changeSet.author: codex
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE agent_message ADD CONSTRAINT ck_agent_message_role CHECK (role IN ('USER','USER_ACTION','ASSISTANT','TOOL','SYSTEM_SUMMARY'))
ALTER TABLE agent_message ADD CONSTRAINT ck_agent_message_content_kind CHECK (content_kind IN ('TEXT','ACTION','TOOL_CALL','TOOL_RESULT','ARTIFACT','SUMMARY'))
ALTER TABLE agent_message ADD CONSTRAINT ck_agent_message_sequence CHECK (sequence_number > 0)

ALTER TABLE agent_run ADD CONSTRAINT ck_agent_run_counts CHECK (iteration_count >= 0 AND tool_invocation_count >= 0 AND last_event_cursor >= 0 AND (input_tokens IS NULL OR input_tokens >= 0) AND (output_tokens IS NULL OR output_tokens >= 0))

ALTER TABLE agent_run ADD CONSTRAINT ck_agent_run_timestamps CHECK ((status = 'QUEUED' AND completed_at IS NULL) OR (status = 'RUNNING' AND started_at IS NOT NULL AND completed_at IS NULL) OR (status IN ('WAITING_FOR_USER','COMPLETED','FAILED','CANCELLED') AND completed_at IS NOT NULL))
ALTER TABLE agent_tool_invocation ADD CONSTRAINT ck_agent_tool_risk CHECK (risk_class IN ('READ','REVERSIBLE_MUTATION','CHECKOUT_PREPARATION'))
ALTER TABLE agent_tool_invocation ADD CONSTRAINT ck_agent_tool_status CHECK (status IN ('PROPOSED','RUNNING','COMPLETED','FAILED','UNCERTAIN','REJECTED','CANCELLED'))

ALTER TABLE agent_tool_invocation ADD CONSTRAINT ck_agent_tool_timestamps CHECK ((status = 'PROPOSED' AND started_at IS NULL AND completed_at IS NULL) OR (status = 'RUNNING' AND started_at IS NOT NULL AND completed_at IS NULL) OR (status IN ('COMPLETED','FAILED','UNCERTAIN','REJECTED','CANCELLED') AND completed_at IS NOT NULL))
ALTER TABLE agent_tool_invocation ADD CONSTRAINT ck_agent_tool_completed_result CHECK (status <> 'COMPLETED' OR result_json IS NOT NULL)

ALTER TABLE agent_run_event ADD CONSTRAINT ck_agent_event_type CHECK (event_type IN ('RUN_STARTED','ASSISTANT_DELTA','ASSISTANT_COMPLETED','TOOL_PROPOSED', 'TOOL_STARTED','TOOL_COMPLETED','TOOL_FAILED','ARTIFACT_UPSERTED','CART_CHANGED', 'CHECKOUT_READY','RUN_WAITING_FOR_USER','RUN_COMPLETED','RUN_FAILED','RUN_CANCELLED'))
ALTER TABLE agent_run_event ADD CONSTRAINT ck_agent_event_version_cursor CHECK (schema_version > 0 AND cursor > 0)
ALTER TABLE shopping_mission ADD CONSTRAINT ck_shopping_mission_status CHECK (status IN ('ACTIVE','READY','CHECKOUT_PREPARED','COMPLETED','CANCELLED'))

ALTER TABLE agent_artifact_reference ADD CONSTRAINT ck_agent_artifact_type CHECK (artifact_type IN ('PRODUCT','OFFER','INVENTORY_ITEM','ORDER','SAVED_PRODUCT','PRODUCT_STATE', 'COMPARISON','REVIEWS','DISCOUNT_CODES','MISSION','CART','CART_LINE','CHECKOUT'))
ALTER TABLE agent_artifact_reference ADD CONSTRAINT ck_agent_artifact_ordinal CHECK (ordinal > 0)
ALTER TABLE agent_artifact_reference ADD CONSTRAINT ck_agent_artifact_tool_run CHECK (tool_invocation_id IS NULL OR run_id IS NOT NULL)
ALTER TABLE agent_user_action ADD CONSTRAINT ck_agent_user_action_status CHECK (status IN ('RESERVED','RUNNING','COMPLETED','FAILED','UNCERTAIN'))

ALTER TABLE agent_user_action ADD CONSTRAINT ck_agent_user_action_timestamps CHECK ((status = 'RESERVED' AND started_at IS NULL AND completed_at IS NULL) OR (status = 'RUNNING' AND started_at IS NOT NULL AND completed_at IS NULL) OR (status IN ('COMPLETED','FAILED','UNCERTAIN') AND completed_at IS NOT NULL))
ALTER TABLE agent_user_action ADD CONSTRAINT ck_agent_user_action_completed_result CHECK (status <> 'COMPLETED' OR (message_id IS NOT NULL AND result_json IS NOT NULL))
